candidates.excerpt: Gachibowli police and the Anti-Human Trafficking Unit busted an alleged prostitution racket operating from a hotel in Hyderabad, detaining three men and three women from Uzbekistan and seizing cash, mobile phones and other materials.

candidates.title: Telangana’s Sandhya Reddy elected Mayor of Strathfield; Revanth extends wishes
candidates.excerpt: Chief Minister A. Revanth Reddy congratulated Telangana-born Sandhya (Sandy) Reddy on her election as the 73rd Mayor of Strathfield Council in Sydney, Australia. An alumna of Osmania University and native of Vikarabad district, she will serve a two-year term, drawing praise from political leaders across Telangana.

candidates.title: Stabbing on Dubai-Tel Aviv flydubai flight: What happened and what we know so far
candidates.excerpt: A co-pilot of a flydubai aircraft carrying more than 170 passengers from Dubai to Tel Aviv allegedly stabbed the pilot and attempted to crash the plane

candidates.title: Passenger on rerouted flydubai flight claims pilot tried to crash plane
candidates.excerpt: ‘It was really on the way to crashing, and it was simply the resourcefulness of many people who took control of the co-pilot and neutralised him,’ said a passenger who was onboard

candidates.title: Trump says flydubai pilot 'a hero', plumber steadied plunging aircraft
candidates.excerpt: The pilot who staved off the attempt to crash the aircraft has been identified as Smit Machchhar, an Indian national, and hailed a "hero" by Benjamin Netanyahu and many others
